meta.name: State GSDP / NSDP / per-capita NSDP, base 2011-12 (MoSPI National Accounts Statistics)
meta.source_org: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), National Statistics Office; fill-in from Reserve Bank of India (DBIE Handbook of Statistics)
meta.published: 2025-2026 (state estimates: 2023-24 Quick Estimates, 2024-25 Advance Estimates; the API gives no release date)
meta.limitations: Base year 2011-12. MoSPI NAS gives no GSDP or NSDP value for Assam, Haryana, Nagaland, Ladakh, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, Lakshadweep: these are null in the MoSPI columns (the API does return per-capita GSDP for Assam, Haryana, Nagaland, Ladakh; Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu and Lakshadweep have no row). For Assam, Haryana and Nagaland the RBI Handbook gives NSDP: it is in separate *_rbi columns. GSDP for these states is null (no official GSDP file reached). 2023-24 is the common year because 2024-25 is only an Advance Estimate. State series are not strictly comparable across states for methodology reasons.
meta.method: Downloaded all states and years 2011-12..2024-25 from the MoSPI NAS API (series=Current, indicators 23 GSDP, 24 NSDP, 25 per-capita NSDP, 31 per-capita GSDP). Row values are the 2023-24 values; `series` holds all years. No unit conversion (INR crore; per-capita INR). Null values stay null.
